payload.method: Deterministic inventory: walk each payload root (skills, commands, agents, hooks, mcp) recursively from the plugin root; reject symlinks and non-regular files; skip entries named .gitkeep, __pycache__ directories, and .pyc bytecode; include only regular files with st_nlink == 1. Record {path, sha256} per file with the POSIX path relative to plugins/lazyzcode and sha256 over the file bytes. Append policy.files entries the same way. Sort records byte-wise (Buffer.compare) by path. file_count is the record count; inventory_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the UTF-8 JSON serialization of the sorted record array (JSON.stringify with default separators, no whitespace, insertion order = sorted path order).
